## Change and reason

Describe the subsystem, evidence and intended effect.

## Verification

List source/build checks and physical tests separately. Include failures,
untested gates and the exact runtime identity where relevant.

## Review checklist

- [ ] Commits are signed and include DCO sign-off; original authorship is retained.
- [ ] Kernel changes are represented by the owning subsystem patch.
- [ ] Hardware claims match actual physical evidence.
- [ ] No secrets, device-private identifiers or unauthorized firmware are included.
- [ ] Recovery and the known-working BOOT/SYSTEM path remain intact.
